pairsWith.noteUz: Diqqatga sazovor joylar lug'ati coursebook 62-bet 1-2-mashqlar va 63-bet 5-6-mashqlarga (Wieliczka tuz koni matni) mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 9-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (38-bet). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 9', yonida katta qora 'A World of Wonders'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1) 'Read the descriptions of the places and fill in the missing words.' Qiya: 'open, named, built, carved, visited, situated, performed, designed, lined, made'. 4 SURAT va 4 MATN: A (Rialto ko'prigi, gondolalar): 'Rialto Bridge was 1) ...... by Antonio da Ponte and was 2) ...... over Venice's Grand Canal. It is twenty metres wide and 3) ...... with pretty little shops and stalls.' B (Kreml): 'The Kremlin is in the centre of Moscow, Russia. It is 4) ...... of red brick and has twenty towers. Inside the Kremlin are many churches and palaces which are 5) ...... to the public and are 6) ...... by millions of tourists every year.' C (Royal Albert Hall): 'The Royal Albert Hall near Kensington Gardens in London is a circular building with a huge domed roof. It is 7) ...... after the husband of Queen Victoria of England. Many famous musicians and orchestras have 8) ...... at the Royal Albert Hall.' D (Sfinks): 'The Sphinx in Egypt is one of the most famous landmarks in the world. It is also one of the oldest. It was constructed over 4,000 years ago. The face of King Khafre, the King of Egypt at that time, is 9) ...... into the rock. The Sphinx is 10) ...... close to the pyramids.' Suratlarda 1-4 katakchalar (moslash uchun).

O'NG USTUN:
2) 'Underline the correct word.' 1 Although the lake is man-made/traditional, it is still beautiful. 2 Unfortunately, pollution has broken/damaged the monument. 3 You can find out more at the information desk/table. 4 Stonehenge is a famous building/landmark. 5 They have been invited to the opening/open day of a new art gallery. 6 The artist had used water colours in his painting/carving. 7 The telephone was invented/discovered by Alexander Graham Bell. 8 The Romans completed/located the Colosseum in 82 AD. 9 They told us not to touch the exhibitions/exhibits. 10 Entry to the museum was free of/from charge.
3) 'Fill in the missing adjectives from the list.' Qiya: 'old, traditional, fascinating, enormous, popular, unforgettable'. 'Jorvik Viking Centre, York. The Jorvik Viking Centre is a 1) ...... place to visit, with many strange and delightful sights to see. The museum is located underground, in the 2) ...... town of York. Visitors can see part of the Viking town that was discovered when a local shopping centre was being built. The museum has a display of 3) ...... costumes. You can also see an 4) ...... old wooden fishing boat, which is a 5) ...... exhibit with many tourists. Visitors to this museum will spend an 6) ...... time here.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '38'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the descriptions of the places and fill in the missing words: open, named, built, carved, visited, situated, performed, designed, lined, made. A Rialto Bridge (Venice); B The Kremlin (Moscow); C The Royal Albert Hall (London); D The Sphinx (Egypt).
exercises.instructionUz: Joylar tavsifini o'qing va tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying: open, named, built, carved, visited, situated, performed, designed, lined, made. A Rialto ko'prigi (Venetsiya); B Kreml (Moskva); C Royal Albert Hall (London); D Sfinks (Misr).
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQATGA SAZOVOR JOYLAR -
  MAJHUL NISBAT (be + V3).

  was DESIGNED by - loyihalangan
  was BUILT over - qurilgan
  is LINED with - qatorlangan
  is MADE of - yasalgan
  are OPEN to the public - ochiq
  are VISITED by - tashrif
    buyuriladi
  is NAMED after - nomlangan
  have PERFORMED - chiqish
    qilishgan (faol!)
  is CARVED into - o'yib ishlangan
  is SITUATED close to - joylashgan

  ⚠ 9-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI - MAJHUL
  NISBAT: coursebook 64-bet.


JOYLAR:

  A Rialto Bridge - Venetsiya,
    1591, me'mor Antonio da Ponte
    (5-betda surati bor edi!)
  B Kremlin - Moskva, qizil g'isht,
    20 minora
  C Royal Albert Hall - London,
    1871, shahzoda Albert nomida
  D Sphinx - Misr, 4500 yil, fir'avn
    Xafra yuzi


⚠ 'TO BE NAMED AFTER':

  = ... nomiga qo'yilgan.


⚠ 'A DOMED ROOF':

  = gumbazli tom.


⚠ 'A LANDMARK':

  = diqqatga sazovor joy, mo'ljal.


⚠ 'STALLS':

  = rastalar.

items.sentence: A: Rialto Bridge was ___ by Antonio da Ponte
items.uz: Rialto ko'prigi Antonio da Ponte tomonidan loyihalangan

items.sentence: and was ___ over Venice's Grand Canal.
items.uz: va Venetsiyaning Katta kanali ustiga qurilgan.

items.sentence: It is twenty metres wide and ___ with pretty little shops and stalls.
items.uz: U yigirma metr kenglikda va chiroyli kichik do'kon va rastalar bilan qatorlangan.

items.sentence: B: The Kremlin is in the centre of Moscow, Russia. It is ___ of red brick and has twenty towers.
items.uz: Kreml Moskva, Rossiya markazida. U qizil g'ishtdan qurilgan va yigirmata minorasi bor.

items.sentence: Inside the Kremlin are many churches and palaces which are ___ to the public
items.uz: Kreml ichida jamoatchilik uchun ochiq ko'plab cherkov va saroylar bor

items.sentence: and are ___ by millions of tourists every year.
items.uz: va har yili millionlab turistlar tashrif buyuradi.

items.sentence: C: The Royal Albert Hall near Kensington Gardens in London is a circular building with a huge domed roof. It is ___ after the husband of Queen Victoria of England.
items.uz: Londondagi Kensington bog'lari yaqinidagi Royal Albert Hall ulkan gumbazli tomli dumaloq bino. U Angliya qirolichasi Viktoriyaning turmush o'rtog'i nomiga qo'yilgan.

items.sentence: Many famous musicians and orchestras have ___ at the Royal Albert Hall.
items.uz: Ko'plab mashhur musiqachi va orkestrlar Royal Albert Hallda chiqish qilishgan.

items.sentence: D: The Sphinx in Egypt is one of the most famous landmarks in the world. It is also one of the oldest. It was constructed over 4,000 years ago. The face of King Khafre, the King of Egypt at that time, is ___ into the rock.
items.uz: Misrdagi Sfinks dunyodagi eng mashhur yodgorliklardan biri. U eng qadimiylaridan ham biri. U 4000 yildan ko'proq oldin qurilgan. O'sha davrdagi Misr qiroli Xafraning yuzi toshga o'yib ishlangan.

items.sentence: The Sphinx is ___ close to the pyramids.
items.uz: Sfinks piramidalarga yaqin joylashgan.

exercises.explanationUz:
LUG'AT (coursebook 63-bet
  5-6-mashqlar).

  man-made = sun'iy (inson qurgan)
  damaged = shikastlangan
    (pollution - zarar)
  information desk = ma'lumot
    stoli
  landmark = diqqatga sazovor joy
    (Stonehenge - bino EMAS)
  opening = ochilish marosimi
  painting = rasm (water colours
    bilan)
  invented = ixtiro qilingan
    (telefon - yangi narsa)
  completed = tugatilgan
  exhibits = eksponatlar (narsalar)
  free of charge = bepul


⚠ INVENT vs DISCOVER:

  invent = ixtiro qilmoq (yangi
    narsa yaratish - telefon)
  discover = kashf qilmoq (bor
    narsani topish - Amerika)


⚠ EXHIBITION vs EXHIBIT:

  exhibition = ko'rgazma (tadbir)
  exhibit = eksponat (buyum)


⚠ 'FREE OF CHARGE':

  = bepul (turg'un ibora).


⚠ '82 AD':

  = milodiy 82-yil. AD = Anno
  Domini.

items.textEn: Although the lake is man-made/traditional, it is still beautiful.
items.uz: Ko'l sun'iy bo'lsa ham, baribir go'zal.

items.textEn: Unfortunately, pollution has broken/damaged the monument.
items.uz: Afsuski, ifloslanish yodgorlikni shikastlagan.

items.textEn: You can find out more at the information desk/table.
items.uz: Ma'lumot stolida ko'proq bilib olishingiz mumkin.
Stounxenj mashhur diqqatga sazovor joy.

items.textEn: They have been invited to the opening/open day of a new art gallery.
items.uz: Ular yangi san'at galereyasining ochilishiga taklif qilingan.

items.textEn: The artist had used water colours in his painting/carving.
items.uz: Rassom rasmida akvarel ishlatgan edi.

items.textEn: The telephone was invented/discovered by Alexander Graham Bell.
items.uz: Telefon Aleksandr Grem Bell tomonidan ixtiro qilingan.

items.textEn: The Romans completed/located the Colosseum in 82 AD.
items.uz: Rimliklar Kolizeyni milodiy 82-yilda tugatishgan.

items.textEn: They told us not to touch the exhibitions/exhibits.
items.uz: Ular bizga eksponatlarga tegmaslikni aytishdi.

items.textEn: Entry to the museum was free of/from charge.
items.uz: Muzeyga kirish bepul edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing adjectives from the list: old, traditional, fascinating, enormous, popular, unforgettable. (Jorvik Viking Centre, York)
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan tushib qolgan sifatlarni qo'ying: old, traditional, fascinating, enormous, popular, unforgettable. (Jorvik Viking markazi, York)
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFATLAR - MUZEY TAVSIFI.

  a FASCINATING place - qiziqarli
    joy
  the OLD town of York - eski
    shahar
  TRADITIONAL costumes - an'anaviy
    liboslar
  an ENORMOUS old boat - ulkan
    ('an' - unli!)
  a POPULAR exhibit - mashhur
    eksponat
  an UNFORGETTABLE time -
    unutilmas ('an' - unli!)

  ⚠ 'a(n)' artikli KALIT: 'an'
  turgan joyga unli bilan
  boshlanadigan sifat (enormous,
  unforgettable, old).


⚠ JORVIK VIKING CENTRE:

  = York (Angliya)dagi viking
  muzeyi - 1970-yillarda savdo
  markazi qurilayotganda topilgan
  viking shahri o'rnida (haqiqiy!).


⚠ 'DELIGHTFUL SIGHTS':

  = yoqimli manzaralar.


⚠ 'UNDERGROUND':

  = yer ostida.


⚠ 'A DISPLAY OF':

  = ... ko'rgazmasi.


⚠ 'WAS BEING BUILT':

  = qurilayotgan edi (majhul
  continuous).

items.sentence: The Jorvik Viking Centre is a ___ place to visit, with many strange and delightful sights to see.
items.uz: Jorvik Viking markazi ko'plab g'alati va yoqimli manzaralari bilan tashrif uchun qiziqarli joy.

items.sentence: The museum is located underground, in the ___ town of York.
items.uz: Muzey yer ostida, Yorkning eski shahrida joylashgan.

items.sentence: Visitors can see part of the Viking town that was discovered when a local shopping centre was being built. The museum has a display of ___ costumes.
items.uz: Tashrif buyuruvchilar mahalliy savdo markazi qurilayotganda topilgan viking shahrining bir qismini ko'rishlari mumkin. Muzeyda an'anaviy liboslar ko'rgazmasi bor.

items.sentence: You can also see an ___ old wooden fishing boat,
items.uz: Shuningdek, ulkan eski yog'och baliqchi qayig'ini ko'rishingiz mumkin,

items.sentence: which is a ___ exhibit with many tourists.
items.uz: u ko'plab turistlar orasida mashhur eksponat.

items.sentence: Visitors to this museum will spend an ___ time here.
items.uz: Bu muzeyga tashrif buyuruvchilar bu yerda unutilmas vaqt o'tkazadilar.

It is named after the husband of Queen Victoria.

patterns.exampleEn: The Sphinx is situated close to the pyramids.
